title: DCLab Code: image attachments saved whole as files, referenced in the record
request: Continue without stopping, and capture, record and store data for training the six models.
plan: Take images with a message as Claude Code does
Keep each image whole without putting image data into text records
Test on the server, on the page and live

decisions.decision: Each image saved as its own file; the record holds file, type, size and sha256
decisions.why: records stay text; R&D keeps text and counts images, since no redaction reads a screenshot

decisions.decision: Bytes checked against the declared type, 5 images of 5 MB at most
decisions.why: a renamed file is refused; the Messages API's limit per image

change: server/attachments.js; engine send with images; an SDK echo recorded with the reference; GET of a saved image with the token; paperclip, paste, drop and previews on the page.

findings.defect: an assumption that the SDK echoes a streamed image back
findings.scenario: a live probe sent an image and a question; no user message with the image came back
findings.cause: the SDK does not replay a streamed message
findings.fix: the reference step for echoed images stays as a safety net, tested with a fake echo

measurements.name: image tests and a live probe
measurements.gate: server and page tests pass and the model reads the attached image
measurements.result: 41 tests passed; Haiku described the 1x1 PNG as very small for USD 0.006

outcome: Images go with a message and are kept whole as files, while records and R&D's store hold only their references and counts.
lessons: Check live whether an SDK echoes what you send before building on it
risks: a screenshot may hold a secret: kept on this Mac, counted only in the store
